description: Analyze inline code for security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, XSS, SQL injection, insecure patterns). Pass code as a string parameter. For scanning files on disk, use scan_file instead. Example: check_code({code: 'app.get(...)', language: 'javascript'})

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

framework.description: Framework context (e.g. express, nextjs, fastapi, react, django)

name: check_code
